source.decision: Decision card '按检查稿改 DC007（空表、批注、合计行、统一核对）吗？': 全部按建议.

gaps_found: Empty sheets triggered a DC-split call and an UNASSIGNED item (or a HUMAN_REVIEW finding without a run).
DC-split received cell values only; comments and comment-only cells were dropped, leaving them unassigned.
Header checks applied only to DC-split; model titles were not verified against the sheet.
Explicit plans could not name note blocks, so footnotes became body rows or unassigned cells.
A rejected proposal lost the model's own findings.
Excel totals rows were read as body rows and headerless tables used their first data row as header (intake records only name and ref).
Rule text claimed full-coverage verification; code keeps uncovered cells as an UNASSIGNED item.
changes: data_agents.py: empty_sheets; comments to DC-split; check_split and attach_notes shared by all methods; title check with NOT_FOUND; plan note_blocks; Excel header/totals counts when intake supplies them; rejected proposals keep findings.
tests: empty sheet, comments, titles, explicit plan notes and headers, totals rows.

data_agents.py (DC002 follow-through): intake now records hidden_rows and hidden_columns; tables containing them carry both lists and a FOLLOW_UP HIDDEN_ROWS_OR_COLUMNS finding, DC-split sees them, and older snapshots mark hidden_rows_and_columns NOT_RECORDED.
follow_up: Intake owner asked to record header_row_count and totals_row_count for Excel tables.
